priceSourceNote: Live item prices come from the booking app's public JSON endpoint https://book.kitkeeper.co.uk/api/products/price (values in pence). They match the T&Cs and the homepage FAQ.

collection.notes: A flat fee per order, paid at booking. The price is the same for a student house or halls, with collection from the ground floor or reception. I found no separate house vs halls price. Optional extras: Timeslot +£35, Doorstep +£60 (collection from your flat door on any floor, in select areas).
collection.quote: from the ground floor or reception as part of the standard service collection fee of £45. A Timeslot collection can be arranged for an additional fee of £35 and / or a Doorstep collection for an additional fee of £60, on top of the standard collection fee

return.notes: Charged per box at the end of storage. Add £3.99 per box if the boxes go back to a different city (postcode area) from the one they were collected in. Timeslot (+£35) and Doorstep (+£60) options apply. Needs 3 working days' notice. No returns at weekends or on bank holidays.
return.quote: There is a return charge of £6.95 per Box or Non Boxed Item for a standard return to the ground floor or reception of the Return Address.

handling.notes: I found no routine per-item handling fee. Handling is charged only as a penalty (overweight or oversized boxes, repacking), and only the overweight penalty has a fixed amount (see other).
handling.quote: There will be a charge for any packing or repacking.

boxesPurchase.notes: You buy Kit Keeper's boxes once and pay £12.99 to have the empty boxes delivered. The booking code charges this fee whenever any non-own box is ordered. Box purchases are non-refundable. The alternative is 'Own box': no purchase or delivery fee, but £15/month storage. Prices are from the /api/products/price purchaseCost field.
boxesPurchase.quote: In addition to the storage costs you can expect to pay the collection fee of £45 plus delivery of empty Kit Keeper boxes at £12.99.

insurance.notes: Kit Keeper sells no insurance. Its liability is capped at £100 per box (the lowest of cost price, replacement cost or £100). University pages call this '£100 free cover per box'. Kit Keeper recommends your own insurance. I found no paid upgrade.
insurance.quote: does not insure or arrange insurance for the box Goods or Non Boxed Items. Kit Keeper recommends that you arrange your own insurance ... shall not in any event exceed the lower of: (i) The cost price of the Non Boxed Items and Goods in the Box; (ii) The current replacement cost ...; (iii) £100.

minimumCharge.notes: The minimum charge is one month of storage at the per-box monthly rates (£21.50 for 1S+1M+1L). After that, storage rolls week by week and is billed monthly. The first storage payment is taken 7 days after collection.
minimumCharge.quote: By purchasing a Storage Service, on a rolling week by week basis with a minimum storage term of one month. The payments would still be processed monthly, but the final storage period would be rounded up to a weekly value if the total storage period is more than one month

worked.scenario: 1 small + 1 medium + 1 large, DH1, 4 weeks (1-month minimum)
worked.arithmetic: Upfront: boxes 3.00+4.50+5.50=13.00; collection 45.00; empty-box delivery 12.99; DH surcharge 0 => 70.99. Storage: 3.00+8.50+10.00=21.50/month x 1-month minimum = 21.50. Return: 3 x 6.95 = 20.85. Total 70.99+21.50+20.85 = 113.34

Fixed 70.99 + 20.85 = 91.84. Storage is rounded up weekly. Assumed weekly rate = monthly x 12/52 = 21.50 x 12/52 = 4.9615/wk; 15 x 4.9615 = 74.42. Total 91.84 + 74.42 = 166.26. If billed as 4 whole months instead: 86.00 -> 177.84.
worked.confidence: medium: the weekly pro-rata formula is not published; the T&Cs only say the final period is rounded up to a weekly value

notes: The user's ~£80 figure matches 45.00 collection + 12.99 box delivery + 21.50 first-month storage = 79.49. That leaves out the box purchase (£13.00, a separate line) and the end-of-storage return (£20.85, paid later). The full door-to-door cost for 1 month is £113.34. The Durham location page says 'start at just £3 a month rising to £6.50 for larger box sizes', which is out of date: the live API has medium at £8.50, large £10 and XL £12. Fixed costs per booking come to £91.84 before any storage (£70.99 upfront including boxes, plus £20.85 return), so short stays are expensive. Using 3 own boxes instead: 45 collection + 0 delivery + 45.00/month storage + 20.85 return. There is no paid insurance; liability is capped at £100 per box. Kit Keeper has a Trustpilot page (www.kitkeeper.co.uk, about 258 reviews), but no figure here comes from it.
